name: American Financial Group, Inc.
moat_justification: Diversified specialty P&C franchise (~36 niche businesses via Great American) with a combined ratio better than the industry for more than two decades and sustained high returns (fundamentals.json roic_proxy 17.3-19.6% in FY2023-25, ROE 17.5-20.0%), but insurance capacity is close to a commodity: no network effects, modest switching costs, price set by the cycle, and social inflation / catastrophe / alternative-investment returns can erase a year of underwriting profit.

NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (11.6%) vs bull-case tier B (19.5%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Quality specialty P&C insurer, moat 5/10 — B by numbers (16.1% weighted IRR, IV@15% $163 vs $149 price) but the OCF base capitalizes float (TTM OCF $1,566M vs TTM net income $953M), so sized down to C per the insurer-float rule and the bear end (C) of the tier band; clears 15% only below ~$163 on these inputs.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
tier_override_reason: Insurer-float softening (Andrew's standing rule, 2026-10-15): the OCF-based owner's-earnings base capitalizes float — TTM OCF $1,566M vs TTM net income $953M (fundamentals.json), and FY2023/FY2025 show the same >40% NI/OCF divergence — so the final tier is sized down one notch from tier_by_numbers B to C, even though the TTM base ($18.63/share) sits close to the normalized median ($18.14/share). This also lands on the bear end of the TIER_BAND (bear C 11.6% vs bull B 19.5%), per the 5.4 sizing rule. Same treatment as PFG/EG/AIZ/ACGL/HIG/WRB.
moat_for: Diversified specialty P&C platform (~36 niche businesses) with granular underwriting expertise in hard-to-insure commercial niches
Combined ratio better than the industry average for more than two decades; 91.5% in Q2 2026
Sustained returns: roic_proxy 17.3-19.6% and ROE 17.5-20.0% in FY2023-25 (fundamentals.json)
Pricing power in the current cycle: renewal rate increases ~5% ex workers' comp for four consecutive quarters through Q2 2026
Disciplined, opportunistic capital allocation: $707M returned in FY2025 including special dividends, debt/total capital 27.5% at FY2025
moat_against: Insurance capacity is close to a commodity — no network effects and low switching costs; pricing is set by the industry cycle, which is softening
Social inflation on U.S. casualty lines and catastrophe exposure can produce reserve charges that erase underwriting profit
Earnings depend materially on investment returns, including alternative investments (7.1% annualized in Q2 2026 vs a 10%+ long-term target) — volatile and market-driven
Gross margin is not a meaningful insurer metric and the roic_proxy is an operating-income construct; the durable evidence is ROE, which is float-levered
Crop insurance seasonality concentrates profitability in Q4; workers' comp pricing was down ~2% in Q2 2026
